pipeline_recommendation.reason: Critical data-quality failures were detected. Investigate them before approving the pipeline.

investigation_results.observed_fact: CustomerID is missing. Transaction may still be valid.
possible_root_causes: Customer information was not captured during checkout.
Customer data was not available in the source transaction.
Customer identification was optional for some purchases.
investigation_steps: Check whether missing CustomerID records are concentrated in particular countries.
Compare missing CustomerID records with invoice types and transaction dates.
Verify whether anonymous purchases are permitted by the business.
investigation_results.recommended_action: Preserve valid transactions. Investigate customer attribution requirements before applying any correction.

possible_root_causes: Product descriptions were not populated in the source system.
Product master data may be incomplete.
Product information may have been lost during data extraction.
investigation_steps: Identify the StockCode values associated with missing descriptions.
Compare missing descriptions against the product master.
Check whether the missing values are concentrated in specific periods.
investigation_results.recommended_action: Enrich descriptions from an authoritative product master where possible.

possible_root_causes: Duplicate transactions may have entered the source system.
Data extraction or ingestion may have processed records more than once.
Duplicate records may have originated from an upstream integration.
investigation_steps: Identify the duplicated transaction keys and exact duplicate rows.
Check source extraction and ingestion logs.
Determine whether duplicates are present in the original source dataset.
investigation_results.recommended_action: Verify duplicates against source records before removing them.

investigation_results.observed_fact: UnitPrice is negative and requires investigation.
possible_root_causes: Incorrect UnitPrice values may have originated in the source system.
A data transformation or mapping error may have changed the price.
Negative prices may represent exceptional business adjustments.
investigation_steps: Extract the two records containing negative UnitPrice values.
Inspect their InvoiceNo, StockCode, Quantity and InvoiceDate.
Check whether these records represent legitimate adjustments or erroneous prices.
Compare the values with the original transaction records.
investigation_results.recommended_action: Treat as a critical investigation item. Do not automatically replace negative prices with zero or delete the transactions.

investigation_results.observed_fact: UnitPrice is zero. Verify whether this is intentional.
possible_root_causes: Zero-priced items may represent promotional or complimentary products.
The source system may have incomplete pricing information.
A pricing transformation may have incorrectly assigned zero.
investigation_steps: Identify the StockCode and InvoiceNo values with zero UnitPrice.
Check whether these items belong to promotional transactions.
Compare zero-priced records with other transactions for the same product.
investigation_results.recommended_action: Verify business context before changing zero-priced transactions.

investigation_results.observed_fact: InvoiceDate is missing or cannot be interpreted as a date.
Quantity is zero and requires investigation.

business_observations.name: Negative quantity records
business_observations.interpretation: May represent returns or credit transactions. Do not automatically classify as invalid.

business_observations.name: Cancelled invoices
business_observations.interpretation: Invoice numbers beginning with C indicate cancellations in this dataset.

important_note: Issue counts across different rules may overlap. They must not be interpreted as unique affected records. Possible root causes are hypotheses and require verification.
